component.name: Loudio
component.summary: Offline transcription studio for audio files and microphone recordings

description.p: Loudio turns speech into text entirely on your own machine. Audio never leaves your computer: transcription runs locally through whisper.cpp, with an OpenAI Whisper Python runtime as a fallback, so the app keeps working without a network connection once its model is downloaded.

ul.li: Record from any microphone and transcribe automatically when you stop
Transcribe existing audio files in MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, AAC and OGG
Choose between speed and accuracy with selectable local runtime profiles
Translate speech into English as an alternative to plain transcription
Watch text appear live while the engine works, with optional timestamps
Review, replay and manage past recordings from a built-in history view
Copy transcripts to the clipboard in one click
Check and repair the local runtime from a guided readiness wizard

description.p: Loudio needs FFmpeg and a Whisper engine on your system. The built-in readiness wizard detects what is missing and installs it for you.

screenshot.caption: Transcribing a microphone recording in the main window
Choosing a local runtime profile, language and output options
The system readiness wizard checking local dependencies

description.p: Transcription can be taught the words you actually use, and the app keeps its external engines up to date without ever installing a pre-release.

ul.li: Steer transcription toward your own technical vocabulary
Learn a correction once and apply it to every later transcript
Offer engine updates only when a newer stable version exists
Install those updates only after you explicitly consent
Recognise every Apple Silicon generation, not a fixed list

description.p: Fixes transcription on Linux, which previously failed on every attempt and fell back to a Python engine that also failed.

ul.li: Stage audio and models where a snap-confined Whisper engine can read them
Verify and resume model downloads so a truncated file no longer breaks every run
Stop reinstalling Python packages before each fallback transcription
Normalise microphone audio to 16 kHz mono before transcribing
Report the real engine error instead of discarding it

description.p: Adds recording history and platform-aware runtime profiles.
